item.title: Limited edition: Etihad's scrapped A380 gets second life
item.description:
UAE watchmaker AIM has unveiled a 380-piece limited watch series built from salvaged parts of Etihad Airways' first A380, priced at $3,250 per unit and shipping in June 2026.
